faqDescription: Here are answers to the most common questions about GalaxisLink.
faq1_answer: We offer several plans starting with our Starter plan for €2.99, which allows you to create your page and use basic features. For advanced capabilities, we offer other paid plans.
faq2_question: What is a digital NFC business card?
faq2_answer: A digital NFC business card is a physical card equipped with an NFC chip. When you tap the card on a smartphone, your GalaxisLink page opens automatically, allowing you to share your contact information and links instantly, without paper.
faq3_question: Can I use my own branding?
faq3_answer: Yes, with our Premium and Enterprise plans, you can completely remove the GalaxisLink branding and use your own logo and color scheme to create a seamless brand experience.
faq4_answer: We take the security of your data very seriously. All data is transmitted encrypted and stored on secure servers within the EU, in accordance with the strict guidelines of the GDPR.
